matteozrybak: Edmund Matteozrybak came up the line in the rain with a cracked shaving mirror and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
First Wave. Edmund Matteozrybak signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a cracked shaving mirror.
Edmund Matteozrybak left the work of a rifleman to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.
A man asked Edmund Matteozrybak to describe Saint-Lune without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Edmund Matteozrybak wrote a letter for Silas Zdsh's mother, because Silas could not find the words. Silas signed it.

On a quiet night Marek Ham (Concord) and Edmund Matteozrybak (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In S-F11, Edmund Matteozrybak listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F11. Edmund Matteozrybak took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Edmund Matteozrybak was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
Edmund Matteozrybak finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Edmund Matteozrybak was carried in at last.
nsrr_007: Nobody asked Konrad Nsrr why he came. Nobody in R-F21 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Konrad Nsrr wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. A letter from home reached Konrad Nsrr before dusk. Konrad Nsrr read it twice and slept a little easier.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Konrad Nsrr. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him. A letter from home reached Konrad Nsrr before dusk. Konrad Nsrr read it twice and slept a little easier.
rezasiibiil: The sergeant gave Benedikt Rezasiibiil a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 5 or any other.
Benedikt Rezasiibiil was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
